author: The Infographics Show
description:
NO ONE IS USING COPILOT.
Microsoft Copilot was supposed to become the future of work, replacing employees, automating office jobs, and leading the AI revolution. Instead, workers are trying to disable it.

Microsoft spent billions integrating AI into Windows, Microsoft 365, Word, Excel, and enterprise systems, betting its entire future on Copilot and OpenAI.
But adoption numbers, user satisfaction, and real-world productivity tell a very different story.

From the controversial Recall feature and privacy backlash, to AI hallucinations, enterprise AI failures, massive data center spending, OpenAI dependence, and Microsoft quietly bringing in Claude AI to fix Copilot’s problems, this is the story of why Microsoft’s biggest AI gamble may already be collapsing.

Why are workers rejecting Copilot? Why are companies paying for AI tools employees barely use? And what happens if the AI bubble finally bursts?

This is why no one is using Copilot.

00:00 - Why No One Is Using Copilot
title: "NO ONE IS USING COPILOT" (The 3.3% Kill Shot)
